              '' -> ''
             '0' -> '+0'
          '1.23' -> '+1.23'
         '-1.23' -> '−1.23'

         '−1.23' -> '−1.23'
            '.5' -> '+.5'
           '-.5' -> '−.5'
           'nan' -> 'nan'
           'inf' -> 'inf'
          '-inf' -> '-inf'
            '--' -> '--'
